story.iWant: to click on a study activity on the dashboard to view its details
story.soThat: I can get more information about the task and prepare for it.
story.tasks: - Enhance `StudyTaskCard` to be clickable. - Implement `onClick` handler for the `StudyTaskCard`. - Implement a `StudyActivityDetailModal` component. - Display details such as topic title, description, course name, scheduled date/time, estimated hours. - Fetch additional details if not already available in the initial `study_sessions` data. - Integrate `StudyActivityDetailModal` with the Dashboard view. - Pass selected study activity data to the modal. - Ensure data displayed is consistent with the data model.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. A user can click on a study activity to view its details (AC3 from Tech Spec). - Clicking a study activity displays a modal or dedicated view with comprehensive details (e.g., topic, description, estimated time, associated course).

constraint.description: The modal or dedicated view for study activity details should load quickly and be responsive to user interaction.
Data fetching for detailed study activity information should be efficient and not cause noticeable delays.
All data fetching for study activity details is subject to the RLS policies on the `study_sessions` and `syllabus_topics` tables.
The application should gracefully handle network issues during data fetching for activity details, providing appropriate user feedback.
Log any errors during data fetching or display of study activity details.
Next.js Frontend direct integration with Supabase for data fetching and display of activity details.
Adhere to Shadcn UI components for a consistent and modern aesthetic for the detail modal/view.

tests.standards: Unit Tests: Test logic for fetching and preparing study activity details for display. Component Tests: Test the `StudyActivityDetailModal` component in various visual states (e.g., with full details, minimal details, loading states). Security Testing: Ensure RLS policies are enforced when fetching `study_sessions` and `syllabus_topics` data for display in the modal.
